how: the bound the note proves, and the facts about the theta triplet it uses, on main (checks/web_first_row_bound.py; no mixing matrix is formed and no measured value appears). For u, v in C^n with sigma(w) = |w.w|/|w|^2 the overlap |<u, v>|^2/(|u|^2 |v|^2) is at most (1 + sigma_u sigma_v + sqrt((1 - sigma_u^2)(1 - sigma_v^2)))/2: the note's proof holds (complex conjugation is an isometry of the Fubini-Study metric and the triangle inequality gives the rest); on 300,000 random pairs in C^2, C^3 and C^5 the largest excess is 3e-16, 300 maximisations reach no excess, and the sharp pairs attain it to 4e-16 on an 11 by 11 grid. An isotropic direction against a real one overlaps by at most one half. The theta triplet is isotropic at every tau (Jacobi; 1e-31 at eight points) and its largest overlap with a real unit vector is one half there; at tau = i the two hand values are 1/2 and 3/8
